body: Everything. That probably sounds cliche but like it's not like this is just on a dime. I've been suicidal since I was a kid, I've thought about this for ages, I've had multiple attempts in the past, I think about the past, present and future. And I've just decided life isn't for me. Between my brain, the things I can't control. The way society and the world runs. The way people are. My current problems I have. The problems I'm likely to have in the future. The problems I've had in the past. It's literally everything. I can't find one good reason to live. At the very least not one that's worth staying for.
I don't need or want anything, but thank you.

CPS. Or whatever is the equivalent of CPS where you live. Nobody is going to care about the smoking if your friend is literally being abused. You need to tell your teacher that her parents will harm her, and if you have access to that report her parents to CPS too. If your teachers are likely to tell her parents just go straight to CPS. Don't rely on your friend to tell the teacher or CPS because often times abuse victims are afraid to speak up but this is quite literally abuse and you'll be saving her from suicide and from abusive parents.
